title: Run registration
description: The body of the signed POST to the server's run endpoint, run.url, application/json, with which a run is registered before it starts. It has two shapes, by the holder's role. A direct node's gateway sends the direct shape: the run's id, its labels and what it is about, and what the gateway announces for the run, forager_version, contract_version, interval_seconds and events; the answer is a signed 200 whose body is the run's run configuration, run-configuration.schema.json, and {"version": 1} is an answer of no policy. A starter, or a keyed machine's qory behind a gateway, sends the gateway shape: the run's id, its labels and what it is about, information alone, and attach_seconds, optional, without the four members of the direct shape, which move to the attach, run-attach.schema.json; the answer is a signed 200 whose body is run-registration-answer.schema.json, with the run key. The server resolves the gateway from the access key's record, never from the body, and refuses a shape that does not match it with a signed 409, node_is_direct or node_uses_gateway. The body is built once and the same bytes are sent on every try, time included, which a server that accepted them under any active key of the same node or node pool answers the same again, and the same run id under another node's key, even with the same bytes, or other bytes, is a signed 409 run_id_used; the signature covers the body, and a server refuses a time outside 300 seconds of its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request, and so is a label value over 256 bytes of UTF-8, which the schema cannot state.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses a version it does not read.

run_id.description: The run's id: a UUID in the canonical lower-case form, the subject of every event of the run.

labels.description: The run's labels, as dev.qory.run.started contains them: at most 16, each value at most 256 bytes of UTF-8. Each maxLength counts characters and is an upper bound of the byte limit: a body with a value over 256 bytes is a signed 400 invalid_request, though this schema passes it. The server decides which labels identify what the run works on, and chooses the run configuration for them. Absent means none.

about.description: What the run is about, as dev.qory.run.started contains it. It is for display: it never selects or changes a security policy. Absent means none.

forager_version.description: The Forager module version, as Go stamps it. In the direct shape alone, where it is required.

contract_version.description: The revision of this contract Forager implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header. In the direct shape alone, where it is required.

interval_seconds.description: The heartbeat interval the run uses, in seconds: heartbeats run from the accepted registration until the run's final event, so the server's liveness window follows the run's own value. A larger value fails the schema, a signed 400 invalid_request. In the direct shape alone, where it is required; behind a gateway the attach carries it.

events.description: The event types the server receives, as its configuration lists them. In the direct shape alone, where it is required.

attach_seconds.description: The attach window the run asks for, in seconds, in the gateway shape alone: absent means the server's default; one above the server's ceiling is clamped to it, and the run key's attach_by states the window granted. Below 1, or not an integer, is invalid_request.

time.description: When the body was built, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds, such as 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z. A server refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401, as it refuses a GET's timestamp.
